name: How can I maximize natural light in my new bathroom?
description: Maximize natural light in a bathroom addition with windows, skylights, or sun tunnels, considering privacy and surrounding structures.

mainEntity.name: How can I maximize natural light in my new bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maximizing natural light in a bathroom addition can be achieved through strategic placement of windows, skylights, or sun tunnels. If privacy is a concern, consider frosted glass options or high-set windows. For homes in densely populated areas like parts of San Francisco, understanding how adjacent structures might impact natural light is a practical tradeoff, possibly necessitating alternative lighting solutions.
